title: Argon 18 Krypton Pro positioning recheck
notes: Exact Krypton Pro page is titled Pro All-Road Bike, sits in Argon 18's All Road universe, describes long rides on tarmac or cobbles to packed gravel races and any surface, and lists up to 40c (43 mm) tire clearance. Aero wording appears only for wheels and cockpit components, not the frame.
